status: PRE-REGISTERED confirmatory measurement of docs/13 amendment A3, hypothesis H8.5 (energy: at equal training joules the CVTM-core beats the from-scratch transformer), lane GX (exclusive GPU). Validation split only; the test split is never loaded. Every GPU job of this config runs alone on the GPU under scripts/gpu_run.sh exclusive, one job at a time.
docs: docs/13 amendment A3 (H8.5, H8.6) and section 5 (energy: median of at least 5 repeats under the exclusive lock, idle subtracted); docs/11 section 11.6 (the fit); src/tmlm/cvtm/energy.py (NVML method, the method of src/tmlm/eval/baselines/transformer_small.py)

cvtm_fit.call: tmlm.cvtm.model.CVTMCore.fit(train tok, train doc_start, vocab=8000, prefix_tokens=None, window=None, min_counts=None, components='full', backend='cupy', max_device_bytes=9 GiB): the frozen fit of results/20260924T085728Z_cvtm_cache_build/ (same call, same CuPy pool limit), without the cache callbacks
cvtm_fit.gpu_steps: the four steps of the fit that run on the GPU: kn_gpu.fit_kn without H, SuffixClauses.from_kn of it (CuPy suffix-link search), kn_gpu.fit_kn on all training documents, SuffixClauses.from_kn of it. Each is wrapped (timing and energy only, the call itself is unchanged) and measured with tmlm.cvtm.energy.EnergyMeter.measure; a device synchronise closes every step
cvtm_fit.cpu_steps: ln P_S on H (suffix_gold) and the document clauses plus MAP-EM (fit_weights) run on the host; they are inside the whole-fit measurement only
cvtm_fit.whole_fit: a second tmlm.cvtm.energy.NvmlPowerSampler over the whole CVTMCore.fit call (reported next to the GPU steps; the CPU steps' GPU energy is whole minus GPU steps, derived)
cvtm_fit.idle: 10 s with the CUDA context created (CuPy) and nothing running, once at the start of the process (the transformer_small method); a 10 s idle sample after every repeat is logged as a diagnostic and not used
cvtm_fit.check_each_repeat: state hash equal to frozen_state_hash (the measured work is the frozen fit)
cvtm_fit.check_once: validation bits per byte of the refitted core equal to frozen_validation_bits_per_byte exactly (after the last repeat, outside the measurement)
cvtm_fit.host_cpu: process CPU seconds (time.process_time, all threads) per step and per fit; CPU energy is not readable in this container (no RAPL)
cvtm_fit.reported_joules: median over the 5 repeats of the idle-subtracted joules of the GPU steps (docs/13 A3 H8.5 'GPU steps'); min and max reported; the whole-fit joules reported the same way
cvtm_fit.memory_rule: before each repeat: memory.current + 14 GiB < 0.80 memory.max, else wait (poll 2 minutes). 14 GiB = the measured peak RSS of this driver over three full-data repeats, 12.48 GiB (results/20260924T104118Z_cvtm_H8_5_fit_energy/, stopped by its owner with exit 143 while it waited on page cache with a conservative 24 GiB bound and held the exclusive lock; not used), plus margin

transformer_m2_settings.source: results/20260922T172902Z_M2_baselines_transformer/ run.json command '.venv-dl/bin/python experiments/m2_baselines.py --family transformer --vocab 8000' and metrics args; the L6 W256 member of the sweep
transformer_m2_settings.determinism: tmlm.eval.baselines.transformer_small.seed_everything(1) before the model is built, CUBLAS_WORKSPACE_CONFIG=:4096:8
transformer_m2_settings.evaluation: tmlm.eval.baselines.transformer_small.bits_per_byte on the validation split (protocol CP, seq_len 256, stride 128, batch 64); per-token log2 P saved for the paired bootstrap and checked to reproduce the same total
transformer_m2_settings.energy: tmlm.eval.baselines.transformer_small.NvmlPowerSampler over the training loop; idle 10 s after the CUDA context exists (torch), once at the start of the process

matched_run.cap_rule: time_cap_s = J_cvtm / 259.2 W, J_cvtm = reported_joules above, 259.2 W = 155,519.8 J / 600 s (docs/13 A3 H8.5, derived constant of the old shared-lock run)
matched_run.rerun_rule: if |J_transformer - J_cvtm| / J_cvtm > 0.10 (idle-subtracted joules of the training loop): rerun ONCE with time_cap_s = J_cvtm / P, P = J_transformer / span_s of the first matched run (its measured idle-subtracted mean power); the rerun is the reported matched run whatever its joules; the first run is reported too

remeasure_600s.rule: the L6 W256 run of transformer_m2_settings with time_cap_s = 600, once, under the exclusive lock; its joules are reported next to the old shared-lock 155,519.8 J
remeasure_600s.name: cvtm_H8_5_transformer_600s_exclusive

verdict.H8.5: MET iff CVTM-core validation bits per byte (frozen_validation_bits_per_byte) < validation bits per byte of the reported matched transformer run; the paired document-block bootstrap of the difference (60 validation documents, 2,000 resamples, tmlm.cvtm.protocol.bootstrap_bpb, labelled derived) is reported with it; no other threshold
verdict.joule_ratio: J_cvtm / 155,519.8 J (old, shared lock) and J_cvtm / J_600s_exclusive (new); no threshold
verdict.H8.6: placement of the CVTM-core against the 600 s L6 W256 transformer: the frozen run's comparison with the old number, and the same comparison with the exclusive-lock re-measurement (paired bootstrap), no threshold

launch.fit_energy: scripts/gpu_run.sh exclusive -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 2 -- .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_H8_5_fit_energy --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_5_energy.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_energy.py --mode fit_energy --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_5_energy.json
launch.matched: scripts/gpu_run.sh exclusive -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_H8_5_transformer_matched --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_5_energy.json -- .venv-dl/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_transformer_tuned.py --mode m2 --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_5_energy.json --cap-from results/<fit_energy run>
launch.matched_rerun: same with --name cvtm_H8_5_transformer_matched_rerun and --cap-from results/<fit_energy run> --rerun-of results/<matched run>
launch.remeasure_600s: scripts/gpu_run.sh exclusive -- scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- .venv-tm/bin/python scripts/mem_guard.py -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_H8_5_transformer_600s_exclusive --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_5_energy.json -- .venv-dl/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_transformer_tuned.py --mode m2 --config experiments/cvtm/configs/H8_5_energy.json --time-cap-s 600
launch.verdict: scripts/cpu_slot.sh 1 -- scripts/run_logged.py --name cvtm_GX_verdicts --config experiments/cvtm/configs/GX_verdicts.json -- .venv-tm/bin/python -u experiments/cvtm_energy.py --mode verdict --config experiments/cvtm/configs/GX_verdicts.json --fit-energy results/<...> --matched results/<...> [--matched-rerun results/<...>] --t600 results/<...> --tuned-lrsel results/<...> --tuned-600 results/<...>

venv: .venv-tm for the fit and the verdict, .venv-dl for the transformer; the two exchange results through files only
